excerpts.author: rahulbarmann
excerpts.content:
Hey everyone, here's my week 7 update! Cristian's types and constants PR getting merged finally unblocked my lane, so this week I raised all three of my PRs into the Lighthouse repo: IL committee derivation, IL signature verification, and the in-memory inclusion list store. Nice side effect of the types landing upstream is that the stack collapsed, all three only ever depended on the types and never on each other, so they're independent now and can be reviewed in any order. I also re-read the Heze specs against each implementation before raising, since they were written a few weeks back. This week I'm starting on wiring the store into BeaconChain along with the read wrappers.

https://hackmd.io/@rahulbarman/r1v36t0Hfx
